decoder: Go 1.27.3 image/png and image/jpeg, after independent structure validation
decoded_raster_accounting: PNG width*height*4 for <=8-bit samples or *8 for 16-bit; JPEG MCU-padded width*height*4. This is an adapter limit, not a claim about total process memory.

png.structure: Full signature, unique first IHDR, bounded chunk sizes and all CRCs; palette/transparency lengths, order and sample range; consecutive IDATs; unique zero-length IEND exactly at EOF.
png.decode: One complete zlib stream consuming all concatenated IDAT payload, exact filtered row byte count and checksum, followed by complete standard-library pixel decoding and explicit palette index bounds.
png.unsupported: Ancillary chunks other than tRNS, animation, EXIF/ICC/text metadata, unknown chunks, interlacing and trailing data are HOLD. No unknown content is skipped.

jpeg.components: 8-bit grayscale component 1, or YCbCr components 1/2/3 with Y sampling 1x1, 2x1 or 2x2 and chroma 1x1; single interleaved baseline scan.
jpeg.jfif: Optional JFIF 1.00/1.01/1.02, valid density units, nonzero densities, no thumbnail.
jpeg.tables: Unique 8-bit nonzero quantization tables; unique baseline DC/AC Huffman tables 0/1 with bounded canonical codes and legal distinct symbols; all referenced tables present.
jpeg.structure: Exact segment bounds, full component scan, baseline spectral fields, exact MCU/block count, Huffman run/category validation and 11-bit signed DC coefficient bounds, FF00 stuffing, one-bit padding and EOI exactly at EOF; complete standard-library pixel decoding follows.
jpeg.unsupported: Progressive/extended/lossless coding, multiple scans, restart intervals/markers, APP metadata other than the allowed JFIF, comments, unknown markers, redefined tables, fill bytes and trailing data are HOLD.

metadata: Expected types png/jpeg, .png or .jpg/.jpeg extensions, image/png or image/jpeg MIME; unspecified/octet-stream permitted; contradictory claims are HOLD.
required_av_input_count: One per original or extracted image instance; raster pixels are not emitted as a new file or counted as another AV input.
failure: HOLD/UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT for malformed or outside-profile images; HOLD/LIMIT_EXCEEDED for decoded raster budget.
